items.author: bralebradycneme.bsky.social
items.context: She's awesome, honestly I remember unlocking Mire on that old childhood flash fan game Godzilla Daikaiju Battle Royale when I played it
items.text: Flash fan games had so much charm. Unlocking a new character felt like a real reward back then.

items.author: ch-art.bsky.social
items.context: Hear about Queen's Domain. Download the demo. "Wow this game looks incredible!" Die to a giant cricket and a flower that shoots lasers in the first dungeon. God, I remember when I was good at video games. Top 10 in Wipeout Fusion time trials. Yoshimitsu main. Trophies. Now, defeated by a cricket.
items.text: Top 10 in Wipeout Fusion time trials is no small thing. That kind of skill doesn't vanish, it just gets rusty. Good luck with the giant cricket.
